privacy.metaDescription: MEDIA Rate privacy policy. Learn how we handle your personal data in accordance with LGPD.
privacy.s1b: MEDIA Rate is operated by 45.370.930 EDINALDO SOARES DA SILVA. For privacy inquiries, contact endart.studios@gmail.com.
privacy.s2b: We collect account data (name, email), subscription data (plan, payment status via Stripe), usage data (watchlist, favorites, history) and essential session cookies (httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax). We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
privacy.s3b: We process your data under the following legal bases: contract execution (providing the contracted service), consent (optional communications via opt-in) and legitimate interest (platform improvements, fraud prevention).
privacy.s4b: Your data is NOT sold. We only share data with: payment provider Stripe (subscription processing) and infrastructure providers (Vercel for frontend hosting, Railway for backend).
privacy.s5b: Your data is kept while your account exists. Upon deletion request, data is removed within 30 days. Audit logs are retained for 6 years.
privacy.s6b: You may exercise the following rights: access (view your data on the Your Data page), correction (update your details in Settings), deletion (request full data removal), portability (export your data in JSON) and consent withdrawal.
privacy.s7b: We employ technical measures to protect your data: cryptographically hashed passwords, httpOnly/Secure/SameSite session cookies, HTTPS-only communication and application-level encryption of sensitive data.
privacy.s8b: This policy may be updated periodically. Significant changes will be communicated via email or platform notification.

about.metaDescription: MEDIA Rate aggregates scores for movies, series and games from public sources into a transparent indicator.
about.ogDescription: MEDIA Rate aggregates scores for movies, series and games from public sources.
about.title: About MEDIA Rate
about.lead: MEDIA Rate aggregates ratings from public sources into a unified and transparent score to help you decide what to watch or play.
about.whatIsBody: MEDIA Rate is a platform that aggregates ratings from public sources — such as TMDB, IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, TVMaze, IGDB, OpenCritic, and Steam — into a single consolidated score, the MEDIA Score™. Instead of checking multiple sites to decide if a movie, series, or game is worth your time, you find the context in one place.
about.whatIsNotBody: MEDIA Rate is not a review nor an editorial opinion. The MEDIA Score™ does not reflect an author's taste — it is a transparent aggregation of public ratings, with an open and verifiable methodology. Each score displays its sources, confidence level, and how much critics and audiences agree.
about.categoriesIntro: The current focus is on three categories: Movies, Series, and Games.
about.categoriesMovie: Movies: aggregated scores from TMDB, IMDb, and Rotten Tomatoes.
about.categoriesSeries: Series: including anime — covered as a genre within Series, with data from TMDB and TVMaze.
about.categoriesGame: Games: scores from IGDB, OpenCritic, and Steam.
about.howItWorksBody: MEDIA Score™ v3 computes the rating per media type with specific weights (critics, audience and consensus) and a Bayesian estimator that pulls titles with few votes toward the catalog average. Consensus feeds the score; the confidence level (High/Medium/Low) and the full methodology are documented on the methodology page.
about.transparencyBody: Every MEDIA Score™ displays its sources and confidence level. No score is hidden — low-confidence scores are flagged, never suppressed. We comply with data protection regulations: you can access, correct, export, or delete your data at any time.
about.languagesBody: MEDIA Rate is available in three languages: Portuguese (Brazil), English (US), and Spanish (Spain). Use the language selector in the top-right corner to switch at any time.
about.roadmapBody: Books and comics/manga are on the roadmap and will arrive as dedicated categories in a future update. Today the focus is on Movies, Series, and Games — the three categories with full source coverage and consolidated scores.

homeContent.whatIsProposalBody: MEDIA Rate consolidates ratings from multiple public sources into a single transparent score, eliminating the need to check several sites to decide what to watch or play.
homeContent.whatIsDifferenceTitle: Difference between a rating aggregator and a single review
homeContent.whatIsDifferenceBody: Unlike a traditional review site where a single person evaluates subjectively, MEDIA Rate aggregates thousands of ratings with statistical weight.
homeContent.whatIsCategoriesBody: Movies, series and games are the current focus. Anime is covered as a genre within Series. Books and comics are on the roadmap.
homeContent.howMethodologyBody: MEDIA Score™ v3 computes the score per media type with specific weights for critics, audience and consensus (e.g. movies 40/40/20), plus a Bayesian estimator that pulls titles with few votes toward the catalog average. Consensus feeds the score and the confidence level is shown transparently.
homeContent.howSourcesBody: We use TMDB, IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, TVMaze, Letterboxd, Trakt, IGDB, OpenCritic, Steam, and SteamSpy as primary sources. Each raw score is normalized to the 0-100 scale.
homeContent.howCoverageBody: MEDIA Rate integrates sources by media type: TMDB and IMDb (movies and series), Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd and Trakt (movies and series), TVMaze (series), IGDB, OpenCritic, Steam and SteamSpy (games).
homeContent.howConfidenceBody: Each MEDIA Score displays a confidence indicator (High / Medium / Low), calculated based on vote volume, number of sources, score dispersion, and data age.
homeContent.catalogNavBody: The MEDIA Rate catalog allows filtering by media type (Movies, Series, Games), genre, release year, and sorting by score, title, or date.
homeContent.catalogDetailBody: Each title has a detail page with: poster, synopsis, cast, genres, release year, streaming platforms, and detailed MEDIA Score.
homeContent.catalogSeasonsBody: Series feature season navigation (horizontal tabs) and episodes (expandable list). Each episode can have its own score when available.
homeContent.searchQuickBody: The search bar with Ctrl+K shortcut lets you find any title instantly. Results include score, type, and year.
homeContent.searchFiltersBody: In the catalog and Discover page, you can filter by media type, sort by score, year or title, and search by keyword.
homeContent.searchRecommendBody: Based on your taste profile and history, MEDIA Rate suggests titles similar to those you have rated or added to your watchlist.
homeContent.plansCompareTitle: Free, Plus and Premium plan comparison
homeContent.plansCompareBody: The Free plan offers a limited catalog and basic MEDIA Score. The Plus plan ({plusPrice}/month) unlocks the full catalog, unlimited watchlist, and AI recommendations. Premium ({premiumPrice}/month) adds advanced taste profile, custom lists, and priority support.
homeContent.plansBenefitsBody: Plus and Premium subscribers have access to the full catalog, personalized AI recommendations, data export, and priority support.
homeContent.plansCancelBody: You can change your plan at any time. Cancellation is instant, with no penalties or advance notice.
homeContent.accountCreateTitle: How to create a free account
homeContent.accountCreateBody: Click Sign up in the top-right corner, fill in your name, email and password. Your Free account is created instantly.
homeContent.accountWatchlistBody: Add any title to your watchlist with one click. Organize into columns: Want to Watch, Watching, Watched.
homeContent.accountPrivacyBody: Your data is protected in accordance with applicable regulations. See our

homeContent.languagesSwitchTitle: How to change the platform language
homeContent.languagesSwitchBody: Use the language selector in the top-right corner (globe icon) to switch between Portuguese, English and Spanish.
homeContent.languagesSeoBody: Each language has localized canonical URLs, metadata and content, ensuring correct search engine indexing.
homeContent.faq1Q: What is MEDIA Score and how is it calculated?
homeContent.faq1A: MEDIA Score consolidates ratings from sources like IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, TMDB, Metacritic, TVMaze, IGDB, OpenCritic and Steam into a single per-media score: games 0-100, other media 0-10.
homeContent.faq2Q: Do I need an account to use MEDIA Rate?
homeContent.faq2A: No. The catalog, search and MEDIA Score are free. Unlimited recommendations require Plus or Premium.
homeContent.faq3Q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
homeContent.faq3A: Yes. All paid plans can be canceled at any time, with no penalties or advance notice.
homeContent.faq4A: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. The amount is adjusted proportionally.
homeContent.faq5A: No. MEDIA Score is a consolidated indicator of rating signals from public sources. It should be used as a starting point for discovery.
homeContent.faq6Q: Which rating sources do you use?
homeContent.faq6A: We use IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, TMDB, Metacritic, TVMaze, Letterboxd and Trakt for movies and series; IGDB, OpenCritic, Steam and SteamSpy for games.

pricingFaq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pricingFaq.faq1Q: What is the MEDIA Score and how is it calculated?
pricingFaq.faq1A: The MEDIA Score consolidates ratings from sources like IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, TMDB, Metacritic, TVMaze, IGDB, OpenCritic and Steam into a single per-media score: games 0-100, other media 0-10, with a confidence indicator (high/medium/low).
pricingFaq.faq2Q: Which rating sources do you use?
pricingFaq.faq2A: We use IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, TMDB, Metacritic, TVMaze, Letterboxd and Trakt for movies and series; IGDB, OpenCritic, Steam and SteamSpy for games.
pricingFaq.faq3Q: Is the MEDIA Score a review?
pricingFaq.faq3A: No. It is a consolidated indicator of public source ratings — it is not a review or editorial opinion. Use it as a starting point, not as a substitute for individual analysis.
pricingFaq.faq4Q: Do I need an account to use it?
pricingFaq.faq4A: No. The catalog, search and MEDIA Score are free. Unlimited recommendations, taste profile and AI assistant require a Plus or Premium plan.
pricingFaq.faq5Q: Can I cancel at any time?
pricingFaq.faq5A: Yes. All paid plans can be canceled at any time, with no penalties or advance notice.
pricingFaq.faq6A: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. The amount is adjusted proportionally.
